description: Stake-weighted bid routing (SWBR): rank task bids by reputation × bond / price instead of lowest price. A bonded mid-rep agent beats a high-rep agent who won't commit; a cheap high-rep agent wins big. Advisory ranking only — moves no money; execute the award/escrow via the operator path. Unbound DIDs carry weight 0.

bond.description: Optional USDC bond the bidder will lock (skin in the game).

name: lawbor_route
